items.title: 車市停滯尋出路 福特入股衛星新創Revolution Space
items.title_en: Car Market Stalls, Seeking a Way Out; Ford Takes Stake in Satellite Startup Revolution Space
paras: 美國汽車大廠福特(F-US)正加速拓展汽車以外的新業務。據《彭博》周一(23日)報導，福特宣布取得美國衛星零件新創公司Revolution Space少數股權，計畫運用自身大量製造複雜產品的經驗，協助對方擴大衛星及推進技術的生產規模。
福特策略長賈賈(Marin Gjaja)在聲明中表示，與Revolution Space建立合作關係，協助其先進太空技術實現工業化與規模化，是福特在具吸引力的高成長市場推動業務多元化、令人振奮的機會。

汽車銷售停滯 福特積極尋找新商機

隨著全球汽車銷售趨於停滯，加上中國車廠持續在國際市場擴大市占率，傳統汽車製造商正積極尋找新的營收來源。
福特去年因電動車相關資產表現不佳，宣布認列195億美元減損，隨後著手建立儲能業務，希望利用尚未充分運用的電池工廠產能。此外，福特也尋求提高汽車零件業務的營收與獲利，並計畫向美國國防部銷售皮卡及軟體。
目前，美國國防部正尋求擴大承包商來源，以改善服務並降低成本，福特希望藉此開拓新的業務機會。

衛星推進技術成切入點 太空投資今年上看千億美元

總部位於波士頓的Revolution Space是美國政府承包商，主要生產衛星推進系統。福特此次透過旗下Ford Industrial LLC子公司進行投資，雙方均未公布投資金額及交易條件。
根據投資公司Space Capital對第三季投資活動的分析，受到SpaceX大型首次公開募股(IPO)、國防支出及太空基礎設施投資帶動，2026年太空經濟投資額可望首度突破1,000億美元。
汽車業者對太空產業的興趣也日益濃厚。豐田汽車(Toyota)與本田汽車(Honda)均已關注相關領域，其中豐田更積極投入投資，並於2025年初宣布向日本太空新創Interstellar Technologies投資4,400萬美元。
paras_en: Ford Motor Co. (F-US) is accelerating its expansion into businesses beyond automobiles. According to Bloomberg on Monday (the 23rd), Ford announced it has acquired a minority stake in U.S. satellite‑components startup Revolution Space, planning to leverage its large‑scale manufacturing expertise to help the company scale up production of satellites and propulsion technology.

Ford’s chief strategy officer Marin Gjaja said in a statement that partnering with Revolution Space to industrialize and scale its advanced space technology represents an exciting opportunity for Ford to diversify its business in an attractive high‑growth market.

Car sales have stalled, prompting Ford to actively seek new revenue sources. With global auto sales flattening and Chinese automakers continuing to expand market share internationally, traditional car makers are looking for fresh sources of income.

Last year, after poor performance of its electric‑vehicle assets, Ford recorded a $19.5 billion impairment and then moved to build a storage‑energy business, aiming to use under‑utilized battery‑factory capacity. The company is also seeking to boost revenue and profit from its auto‑parts operations and plans to sell pickups and software to the U.S. Department of Defense.
The U.S. Defense Department is currently looking to broaden its pool of contractors to improve service and cut costs, and Ford hopes to tap this effort to open new business opportunities.

Based in Boston, Revolution Space is a U.S. government contractor that primarily manufactures satellite propulsion systems. Ford is making the investment through its subsidiary Ford Industrial LLC; neither side disclosed the amount or terms of the deal.

According to Space Capital’s analysis of third‑quarter investment activity, driven by SpaceX’s large IPO, defense spending and space‑infrastructure investment, space‑economy investment could exceed $100 billion for the first time in 2026.

Automakers’ interest in the space sector is also growing. Both Toyota and Honda are watching the space arena, with Toyota taking a more active stance, having announced in early 2025 an investment of $44 million in Japanese space startup Interstellar Technologies.

items.title: 急跌後抄底多數能賺！歷史數據顯示 標普500暴跌10%後  91%機率會漲回來
items.title_en: Most Bottom‑Buyers Profit After Sharp Drops! Historical Data Shows a 91% Chance the S&P 500 Rebounds After a 10% Plunge
paras: 自標普500指數(INX) 迅速跌入技術性回調區間後，市場面臨一個關鍵問題：這究竟是更大規模下跌的開端，還是即將反彈的信號，而歷史統計與華爾街部分策略師的判斷正為後者提供依據。
DataTrek Research共同創辦人Jessica Rabe指出，自2015年以來，標普500在50個交易日內下跌10%的情形中，隨後50個交易日有91%​機率實現上漲，平均漲幅達10.5%。
值得注意的是，未能反彈的11次情況全部發生在2022年Fed激進升息衝擊期間。考慮到市場近期雖擔憂Fed釋放鷹派信號，但其是否會在市場動盪背景下繼續維持強硬立場仍存疑，這一歷史規律或能給投資者帶來一些安慰。
另據《MarketWatch》對其他歷史時期的統計也顯示，在市場下跌10%後買入，總體上仍較為有效，甚至在大蕭條期間，按標普500前身數據，這一策略多數情況下也取得正報酬。
波動率指標同樣釋放值得關注的信號。Rabe指出，VIX收於2021年以來第九高的水位，在此前八次類似高位中，有七次被證明是較好的入場時機。
Berge Report分析師Nancy Berge也表示，當週線VIX從30上方回落時，市場往往會出現一輪可觀反彈。週一早盤，標普500指數期貨上漲約2%，市場情緒有所修復。
摩根士丹利(下稱大摩)首席股票策略師Mike Wilson在最新研報告中轉向更樂觀立場，認為市場此前對明年企業獲利下滑的預期過於悲觀，回調已創造出值得關注的入場機會。這也是他自4月以來最為看多的一次。
Wilson將看多理由歸納為市場情緒、估值和投資者倉位三方面。大摩自有的市場情緒指標綜合波動率、資金流向和倉位等10項數據，目前已降至-1.6，為2018年12月及今年3月美伊戰爭爆發以來的低位。VIX一度升至36，與2018年12月相當，避險基金淨槓桿率降至41%，略低於當時水平。
企業基本面則是另一支撐。Wilson指出，目前獲利預期調整幅度為正10%，而2018年12月為負10%；同時美國勞動力市場仍相當穩健，初領失業金人數處於歷史分佈的最低百分位。獲利預期上調、企業利潤增長與就業韌性同時存在，缺乏足夠理由將當前回調解讀為2027年經濟衰退的前兆。
估值也顯示類似變化。當前股價已反映明年EPS下降6%的預期，但大摩分析師預估，明年EPS增長14%，市場一致預期更達17%；標普500本益比約16倍，低於大摩給出的19至19.6倍合理區間。
Wilson認為，此輪拋售已創造出具有吸引力的入場位置，而這樣的機會並不常見，也不會持續太久。
但看多判斷仍面臨一個重要風險，Fed恐繼續釋放鷹派信號。對此Wilson解釋指出，市場此前調整已在很大程度上替Fed收緊金融條件，美元走強、能源價格上漲，正在壓縮市場流動性，其水平已降至2022年以來低位，甚至比2018年12月更緊張。
因此，Wilson認為，當前市場對Fed政策路徑的定價可能過於鷹派，預計主席華許下月會議上釋放的信號，恐比債市目前預期的更溫和。
眼下，標普500的快速回調仍在考驗投資者信心。歷史數據、倉位出清與估值調整為反彈提供了依據，但Fed後續政策取向，仍是決定市場能否持續修復的重要變數。
paras_en: Since the S&P 500 index (INX) swiftly fell into a technical correction zone, the market faces a key question: is this the start of a larger decline or a signal of an imminent rebound? Historical statistics and some Wall Street strategists are leaning toward the latter.

DataTrek Research co‑founder Jessica Rabe notes that since 2015, in the 50‑day periods when the S&P 500 fell 10%, there is a 91% probability that it rises again in the following 50 days, with an average gain of 10.5%.

It is noteworthy that all 11 instances where a rebound did not occur happened during the aggressive Fed rate‑hike shock of 2022. While the market recently worries about hawkish signals from the Fed, doubts remain about whether the central bank will maintain a tough stance amid market turbulence, and this historical pattern may offer some comfort to investors.

MarketWatch’s statistics for other historical periods also show that buying after a 10% market drop remains generally effective, even during the Great Depression when using data from the S&P 500’s predecessor, the strategy still produced positive returns in most cases.

Volatility indicators are also sending noteworthy signals. Rabe points out that the VIX closed at its ninth‑highest level since 2021, and in the eight previous similar peaks, seven proved to be good entry points.

Berge Report analyst Nancy Berge adds that when the weekly VIX falls back below the 30‑level, the market often experiences a sizable rebound. On Monday morning, S&P 500 futures rose about 2%, and market sentiment improved.

Morgan Stanley (referred to as “MS”) chief equity strategist Mike Wilson turned more optimistic in his latest research note, arguing that the market’s prior expectations of lower corporate earnings next year were overly pessimistic, and the pullback has created attractive entry opportunities. This is his most bullish stance since April.

Wilson cites three reasons for his bullish view: market sentiment, valuation and investor positioning. MS’s proprietary sentiment index, which aggregates volatility, fund flows and positioning across ten data points, has fallen to –1.6, the lowest since December 2018 and the March 2024 US‑Iran conflict. The VIX briefly spiked to 36, comparable to December 2018, while hedge‑fund net leverage dropped to 41%, slightly below the level then.

Fundamentals provide another support. Wilson notes that earnings‑forecast adjustments are now +10% versus –10% in December 2018, and the U.S. labor market remains robust, with initial unemployment claims at the lowest percentile in historical distribution. The combination of upward earnings revisions, profit growth and employment resilience gives little reason to view the current pullback as a prelude to a 2027 recession.

Valuations also show a similar shift. Current stock prices already reflect an expected 6% EPS decline next year, yet MS analysts project a 14% EPS increase for next year, with the market consensus even higher at 17%; the S&P 500 price‑to‑earnings ratio sits around 16×, below MS’s fair‑value range of 19‑19.6×.
Wilson believes this round of selling has created an attractive entry point, a rare opportunity that will not last long.

However, the bullish case still faces a key risk: the Fed may continue to emit hawkish signals. Wilson explains that the market’s prior adjustment has already largely priced in the Fed’s tightening—stronger dollar, higher energy prices—compressing market liquidity to its lowest level since 2022, even tighter than December 2018.

Therefore, Wilson thinks the market may be over‑pricing the Fed’s policy path as hawkish, and expects that the signals Chairman Waller will deliver at next month’s meeting could be milder than the bond market currently anticipates.

At present, the S&P 500’s rapid pullback continues to test investor confidence. Historical data, position unwinding and valuation adjustments provide a basis for a rebound, but the Fed’s future policy direction remains the decisive factor for sustained market recovery.

items.title: 《彭博》揭輝達董事會閃電迎回黃仁勳內幕！川普施壓、高層最後一刻才知情
items.title_en: Bloomberg Reveals NVIDIA Board’s Lightning-Fast Return of Jensen Huang—Trump Pressure, Late‑Stage Executive Awareness
paras: 據《彭博》周一(23日)獨家報導，知情人士透露，輝達(NVDA-US)董事會突然決定恢復黃仁勳(Jensen Huang)的執行長職務，整個決策過程並未徵詢公司高階主管意見，管理團隊直到最後一刻才獲知消息。
這些人士表示，董事會周日下午在美國總統川普(Donald Trump)施加政治壓力後，決定讓先前遭撤換的黃仁勳重返執行長職位。由於相關討論並未公開，知情人士要求匿名。此外，部分原本可能接替黃仁勳的人選，也已表態不參與接班遴選。
據知情人士指出，輝達董事會迎回黃仁勳的計畫，周日短短數小時內便拍板定案，並於周一紐約股市開盤前不久正式宣布。過程中有川普參與，但代理執行長克瑞斯(Colette Kress)及其他高階主管都被排除在外。
在董事會改變決定之前，輝達管理團隊原本正準備迎接首度沒有黃仁勳出席的年度開發者大會。
這場活動預定下周在華盛頓舉行，如今隨著黃仁勳重返執行長職位，大會預料將成為他回歸輝達領導核心的重要舞台。
paras_en: According to Bloomberg’s exclusive Monday (23rd) report, insiders revealed that NVIDIA’s board abruptly decided to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, without consulting senior executives; the management team learned of the decision only at the last moment.

The insiders said the board, after political pressure from President Donald Trump on Sunday afternoon, chose to bring back the previously ousted Huang. The discussion was not public, so sources requested anonymity, and some potential successors declined to participate in the succession process.

Sources indicated that the board’s plan to re‑appoint Huang was finalized within hours on Sunday and formally announced just before Monday’s New York market opening. Trump was involved in the process, but interim CEO Colette Kress and other senior leaders were excluded.
Before the board reversed its decision, NVIDIA’s management had been preparing to host its first annual developer conference without Huang in attendance.
The event, scheduled for next week in Washington, is now expected to serve as a pivotal stage for Huang’s return to NVIDIA’s leadership core.

items.title: iPhone 18 Duo交貨等待近乎腰斬 小摩：蘋果旺季供應限制有望緩解
items.title_en: iPhone 18 Duo Delivery Wait Times Nearly Halved; JPMorgan: Apple’s Seasonal Supply Constraints Likely to Ease
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)iPhone 18系列供應持續改善。摩根大通最新追蹤報告顯示，iPhone 18 Duo全球平均交貨等待時間從前一周的72天縮短至37天，降幅接近五成，消費者預計收貨時間整體提前約一個月；Pro等待時間為2天，Pro Max則縮短至3天。摩根大通認為，供應可見度提高正改善蘋果的供需匹配，有望減輕供應限制對12月季度營收的影響。
不過，各市場改善程度不一。美國與中國的預計交貨日期分別提前至12月27日及26日，但兩地蘋果門市仍無法提供Duo現貨取貨；德國與英國則已有部分星光白配置開放門市取貨。這顯示Duo供應雖明顯改善，主要市場的現貨供應仍未完全恢復。

通路價格跌破官方售價 不等於需求轉弱

隨著Duo供貨增加，通路價格已跌破蘋果官方售價。先前缺貨推高通路成交價，如今交貨時間縮短、市場貨源增加，通路溢價自然面臨回落壓力。
摩根大通追蹤數據顯示，Duo交貨時間縮短主要與供應可見度提高有關。通路價格低於官方定價，不能單獨解讀為消費者需求轉弱，更不能直接等同於銷售不佳。

Pro系列恢復正常 中國門市全配色可取貨

Pro系列供應也進一步正常化。iPhone 18 Pro全球平均交貨等待時間較前一周增加1天至2天，仍接近可立即交貨；Pro Max則縮短5天至3天，已與去年同期持平。
分市場來看，Pro Max在美國、德國及英國的交貨等待時間均為4天，與去年同期一致。中國市場改善最為明顯，Pro與Pro Max等待時間都降至0天，所有配色均可於門市取貨。

旺季供應壓力減輕 美中現貨仍是觀察重點

整體而言，蘋果的供應改善已不再侷限於單一機型。隨著Duo交貨時間大幅縮短、Pro系列恢復至去年同期水準，蘋果在年底購物旺季可望以更充足的貨源因應需求，供應端對出貨與營收的限制正在減弱。
不過，Duo在美國與中國仍無法門市取貨，後續兩地的現貨供應何時恢復，將是觀察蘋果供貨改善程度的重要指標。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) iPhone 18 series supply continues to improve. JPMorgan’s latest tracking report shows the global average delivery wait for the iPhone 18 Duo fell from 72 days last week to 37 days, a drop of almost 50%, moving consumer receipt times forward by about a month; the Pro’s wait is now 2 days and the Pro Max’s has shortened to 3 days. JPMorgan believes higher supply visibility is improving Apple’s supply‑demand match and should lessen the impact of supply constraints on Q4 revenue.

However, the degree of improvement varies by market. Expected delivery dates in the United States and China have moved up to Dec 27 and Dec 26 respectively, but Apple stores in both regions still cannot offer Duo units for in‑store pickup; Germany and the United Kingdom already have some Star‑White configurations available for store pickup. This shows that while Duo supply has clearly improved, on‑hand inventory in key markets has not fully recovered.

Channel prices falling below Apple’s list price does not equal weakening demand. As Duo supply increases, channel prices have slipped beneath Apple’s official price. Previously, shortages pushed channel transaction prices higher; now shorter delivery times and more market inventory naturally put pressure on channel premiums to recede.

JPMorgan tracking data indicates the shorter Duo delivery times are mainly due to higher supply visibility. Prices below Apple’s list price should not be read as a sign of waning consumer demand, nor taken as a direct indication of poor sales.

Pro series supply also normalizes, with all colors available in Chinese stores. The iPhone 18 Pro’s global average delivery wait rose by one day to 2 days, still near‑instant delivery; the Pro Max’s wait shortened by 5 days to 3 days, matching the same period last year.

By market, Pro Max wait times are 4 days in the United States, Germany and the United Kingdom, unchanged from a year ago. The Chinese market shows the most improvement, with both Pro and Pro Max wait times dropping to 0 days and all colors available for in‑store pickup.

Reduced seasonal supply pressure; US‑China inventory remains a key watch‑point. Overall, Apple’s supply improvements are no longer limited to a single model. With Duo delivery times sharply cut and the Pro line back to last‑year levels, Apple should be able to meet holiday‑season demand with a fuller inventory, easing supply‑side constraints on shipments and revenue.

Nevertheless, Duo remains unavailable for in‑store pickup in the United States and China. When on‑hand inventory returns in these two markets will be a crucial indicator of how far Apple’s supply improvements have progressed.

items.title: 黃仁勳一回來就重傷空頭！輝達3倍放空產品暴跌逾91%
items.title_en: Jensen Huang’s Return Deals a Heavy Blow to Short Sellers! Nvidia 3x Inverse Product Plummets Over 91%
paras: 黃仁勳重返輝達(NVDA-US)執行長職位，帶動股價周一(23日)一度大漲約34%，卻讓押注股價下跌的槓桿產品遭遇重擊。一檔在歐洲掛牌的3倍放空輝達產品，盤中一度暴跌逾91%，並曾暫停交易。
綜合財經網站ZeroHedge與ETF專業媒體ETF Stream報導，Leverage Shares發行的3倍反向輝達交易所交易產品(ETP)，其倫敦掛牌、美元計價版本NV3S，一度從上周五收盤的3.475美元跌至0.30美元，跌幅達91.37%。若以上周五收盤價買進，按此價格計算，部位市值僅剩原本約8.6%。
彭博行業研究ETF分析師Eric Balchunas在社群平台X分享相關報價畫面，也指出該產品英鎊計價版本曾顯示「自動暫停交易：超出容許波動範圍」的訊息，引發市場關注。
這場逆轉之前，押注輝達下跌的交易才剛帶來可觀報酬。NV3S從11月9日的約1.75美元，漲至上周五的約3.48美元，短短兩周價格接近翻倍，光是上周五便上漲約37%。
但川普周日晚間公開呼籲輝達重新聘用黃仁勳後，公司董事會周一便宣布讓他即刻復職，並表示在取得美國政府高層意見後，確信其回任不構成國安風險。消息推升輝達股價，也讓反向產品先前的漲勢急轉直下。
這類產品為何跌得如此劇烈？依發行商說明，其目標是在扣除費用前，提供輝達「單日報酬的反向3倍」。簡單來說，輝達若上漲1%，產品理論上便下跌約3%；但遇到盤中再平衡與極端行情時，實際報酬不能直接以整天股價漲幅乘以負3計算。
Leverage Shares也設有被稱為「安全氣囊」的盤中再平衡機制，當標的股價出現約16.67%的不利變動時觸發，以降低極端行情下的損失風險。
據ETF Stream報導，這次急漲確實觸發了該機制，產品暫停交易後已恢復交易。Leverage Shares全球傳訊與策略主管Oktay Kavrak表示，產品並未歸零，安全氣囊發揮了降低全部損失風險的作用。同日，GraniteShares另一檔3倍放空輝達產品3SNV，也一度下跌約92.1%。
Balchunas將這次暴跌與2018年的反向波動率商品XIV事件相提並論。當年市場波動劇烈，XIV指示價值重挫，觸發提前贖回條款，發行商隨後宣布提前贖回。兩者追蹤標的與結構不同，但都呈現出反向產品在行情突然逆轉時，損失可能迅速擴大的特性。
paras_en: Jensen Huang returned to his role as CEO of Nvidia (NVDA-US), sending the stock soaring about 34% on Monday (the 23rd) before dealing a severe hit to leveraged products betting on a price decline. A Europe‑listed 3‑times short Nvidia product plunged more than 91% during trading and was briefly halted.

According to financial site ZeroHedge and ETF‑focused media ETF Stream, Leverage Shares’ 3‑times inverse Nvidia exchange‑traded product (ETP), the London‑listed, USD‑denominated version NV3S, fell from its Friday‑close of $3.475 to $0.30, a drop of 91.37%. Buying at Friday’s close would leave the position’s market value at only about 8.6% of its original amount.

Bloomberg industry‑research ETF analyst Eric Balchunas shared the price chart on X and noted that the GBP‑denominated version of the product displayed a “trading automatically halted: exceeded allowed volatility range” message, drawing market attention.

Before this reversal, the short Nvidia trade had just delivered sizable returns. NV3S rose from roughly $1.75 on Nov 9 to about $3.48 last Friday, almost doubling in two weeks and gaining about 37% on Friday alone.

After former President Trump publicly urged Nvidia to re‑hire Jensen Huang on Sunday night, the board announced on Monday that he would resume his duties immediately, saying that after consulting senior U.S. officials they were confident his return posed no national‑security risk. The news lifted Nvidia’s share price and abruptly reversed the inverse product’s prior rally.

Why did the product fall so dramatically? The issuer explains that its goal is to deliver three times the inverse of Nvidia’s daily return before fees. In simple terms, a 1% rise in Nvidia should cause roughly a 3% drop in the product, but intra‑day rebalancing and extreme moves mean the actual return can’t be calculated by merely multiplying the day’s price change by –3.

Leverage Shares also incorporates an “airbag” intra‑day rebalancing mechanism that triggers when the underlying moves about 16.67% against the position, intended to reduce loss risk in extreme markets.

ETF Stream reported that the sudden surge indeed triggered the mechanism; after the product’s trading halt it resumed trading. Oktay Kavrak, Global Communications and Strategy Head at Leverage Shares, said the product did not go to zero and the airbag helped limit total loss risk. On the same day, GraniteShares’ 3‑times short Nvidia product 3SNV also fell about 92.1%.

Balchunas likened the crash to the 2018 inverse volatility product XIV episode, when severe market turbulence caused XIV’s indicative value to collapse, triggering early redemption provisions and a subsequent redemption announcement. Although the underlying assets and structures differ, both cases illustrate how inverse products can incur rapid, large losses when market direction flips suddenly.

items.title: 黃仁勳復職馬斯克嗨喊『搞定了』！日前才批輝達如踢走喬丹 還想挖角他進SpaceX
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Returns as CEO, Musk Exclaims "It's Done!" After Recently Criticizing Nvidia for Ousting Him, Musk Says He'd Like to Recruit Him to SpaceX
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)周一(23日)宣布黃仁勳正式重返執行長職位，先前多次公開聲援他的特斯拉(TSLA-US)執行長馬斯克(Elon Musk)隨即在社群平台X連續發文慶祝，不僅簡短寫下「搞定了」(It is done)，還引用轉發輝達官方貼文，直言「錯誤已被糾正」，展現對黃仁勳回歸的支持。
根據輝達公告，董事會一致投票通過，立即恢復黃仁勳的總裁、執行長及董事職務。馬斯克的慶祝動作還不只如此。X網友Jason Choi於11月13日發布一張黃仁勳身穿白色皮衣、站在森林中的圖片，並提出讓他以「白袍黃仁勳」(Jensen the White)的形象回歸。
9「白袍黃仁勳」的稱呼令人聯想到《魔戒》中歸來的「白袍甘道夫」(Gandalf the White)，帶有強勢回歸的意味。到了周一黃仁勳正式復職後，馬斯克也在這則貼文下留下火焰的表情符號，表達對這個創意的欣賞。
另一方面，黃仁勳復職也引發美國網友熱議。《紐約時報》先前持續報導黃仁勳涉及的間諜疑雲，在23日發布復職消息後，部分網友湧入留言區嘲諷。

日前才把黃仁勳比作喬丹 直言無人能取代

就在黃仁勳復職前幾天，馬斯克11月18日在《紐約時報》舉辦的DealBook峰會上，公開批評輝達讓黃仁勳離開執行長職位的決定。
他將黃仁勳比作巔峰時期的NBA傳奇球星喬丹(Michael Jordan)，認為在球隊連勝時把喬丹踢出陣容，並不是明智的決定。他強調，黃仁勳在輝達扮演的角色難以取代，不僅親自管理供應鏈，還與重要供應商建立數十年的合作關係，對技術也有深入理解。
馬斯克並指出，許多輝達員工對黃仁勳抱有高度忠誠，即使有其他公司提出更好的待遇，仍選擇留下。他認為，董事會在決定讓這樣的領導者離開前，應該審慎考慮。
對於黃仁勳涉及的爭議，馬斯克當時也表示，黃仁勳確實犯過錯，但他不認為黃仁勳對美國不忠誠，並認為董事會應衡量其貢獻與過失。

不只力挺復職 馬斯克還表態願意延攬

除了公開批評輝達董事會，馬斯克日前被問及是否願意聘請黃仁勳時表示，若能邀請黃仁勳加入旗下的SpaceX，將是一種榮幸。
不過，黃仁勳重返執行長職位，並不代表相關爭議已經結束。輝達董事會表示，針對黃仁勳可能成為外國情報活動目標的調查仍將持續進行，同時也將加強國家安全與出口管制方面的監督。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) announced on Monday (the 23rd) that Jensen Huang has officially resumed his role as chief executive officer, and Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk, who has repeatedly voiced public support for him, immediately posted a series of celebratory messages on X, briefly writing "It's done" and quoting Nvidia's official post, stating "The mistake has been corrected," to show his backing for Huang's return.

According to Nvidia's announcement, the board voted unanimously to immediately restore Huang's positions as president, CEO and director. Musk's celebration went further: an X user named Jason Choi posted a photo on November 13 of Huang wearing a white leather jacket standing in a forest, suggesting he return as "Jensen the White."

The nickname "Jensen the White" evokes Gandalf the White from "The Lord of the Rings," implying a powerful comeback. After Huang officially resumed his duties on Monday, Musk added a flame emoji to the post, expressing appreciation for the creative moniker.

Huang's reinstatement also sparked heated discussion among U.S. netizens. The New York Times, which has been continuously reporting on espionage suspicions surrounding Huang, posted the reinstatement news on the 23rd, prompting some commenters to mock in the comment section.

Just days before Huang's return, Musk on November 18 at the New York Times DealBook summit publicly criticized Nvidia's decision to remove Huang from the CEO role, likening the move to kicking Michael Jordan out of a winning team.

He compared Huang to the peak‑era NBA legend Michael Jordan, arguing that removing Jordan during a winning streak would be unwise. Musk emphasized that Huang's role at Nvidia is irreplaceable, noting his hands‑on management of the supply chain, decades‑long relationships with key suppliers, and deep technical insight.

Musk also pointed out that many Nvidia employees are fiercely loyal to Huang; even if other firms offered better compensation, they would stay. He said the board should have carefully considered before letting such a leader go.

Regarding the controversies surrounding Huang, Musk said at the time that while Huang had indeed made mistakes, he did not view Huang as disloyal to the United States and believed the board should weigh his contributions against any missteps.
Beyond defending Huang's reinstatement, Musk said that if he could invite Huang to join SpaceX, it would be an honor, indicating his willingness to recruit the Nvidia boss.

However, Huang's return as CEO does not mean the related disputes are settled. Nvidia's board said investigations into whether Huang could become a target of foreign intelligence activities will continue, and they will also tighten oversight of national security and export‑control matters.

items.title: 黃仁勳回歸 空頭笑不出來！輝達股價飆33% 單日帳面虧122億美元
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Returns, Shorts Can't Smile! Nvidia Shares Surge 33% with $12.2 Billion Paper Loss in One Day
paras: 黃仁勳意外回歸，讓押注輝達股價下跌的空頭遭遇重擊。據《路透》周一(23日)報導，金融數據公司ORTEX估計，輝達(NVDA-US)放空投資人當天面臨約122億美元帳面虧損，創至少2019年以來最大單日損失。
ORTEX表示，這項估算以每股168.50美元計算，虧損規模足以抹去空頭上周累積的逾105億美元帳面獲利。不過，若從10月29日起計算，放空投資人至今仍有約140億美元帳面獲利。
截至《路透》報導時，輝達股價大漲約33%，報167.14美元。黃仁勳本月稍早因婚外情風波辭職，時隔不到兩周便重返執行長職位，美國總統川普先前也曾公開呼籲讓他回任。
ORTEX共同創辦人Peter Hillerberg指出，空頭自10月底以來仍累積可觀獲利，因此這波急漲雖然造成重大打擊，卻尚未扭轉整筆交易的獲利局面。
至於輝達暴漲是否由「軋空」推動，Hillerberg認為，部分放空投資人可能正在回補，但目前放空股數僅占可流通股數略逾1%，因此這波漲勢看起來主要是市場對黃仁勳回歸消息的反應，而非空頭大量回補造成的軋空行情。
paras_en: Jensen Huang’s unexpected return dealt a heavy blow to short sellers betting on a decline in Nvidia’s stock. Reuters reported on Monday (the 23rd) that financial data firm ORTEX estimated short investors faced about a $12.2 billion paper loss that day, the biggest single‑day loss on record since at least 2019.

ORTEX said the estimate was based on a price of $168.50 per share, a loss large enough to wipe out the more than $10.5 billion of paper gains short sellers had accumulated over the previous week. However, counting from Oct. 29, short investors still hold roughly $14 billion in paper profits to date.

At the time of Reuters’ report, Nvidia’s share price had jumped about 33% to $167.14. Huang had resigned earlier this month amid an extramarital affair scandal, but returned to the CEO role in less than two weeks, a move previously urged publicly by former U.S. President Donald Trump.

ORTEX co‑founder Peter Hillerberg noted that shorts have been building sizable profits since the end of October, so while the sharp rally dealt a significant hit, it has not yet reversed the overall profitability of the trade.

Regarding whether the surge was driven by a short‑squeeze, Hillerberg said some short investors may be covering, but short interest is only just over 1% of the float, so the rally appears mainly a market reaction to Huang’s return rather than a massive short‑cover‑driven squeeze.

items.title: 川普力挺黃仁勳復職 連共和黨議員也不買單：「沒有國安風險？根據什麼？」
items.title_en: Trump Backs Jensen Huang’s Return, Even Republicans Reject It: “No National‑Security Risk? On What Basis?”
paras: 美國總統川普(Donald Trump)周一(23日)接受《CNBC》訪問時表示，他曾敦促輝達(NVDA-US)董事會讓黃仁勳復職，並認為如果沒有他出手，董事會可能不會做出這項決定。不過，川普力挺的這項人事安排，卻引發國會兩黨議員強烈批評，連共和黨議員也不買單。
據《路透》報導，議員紛紛質疑復職決定，要求國會通過限制晶片出口中國的法案，並釐清尚未解決的國家安全疑慮。
預定明年1月出任參議院銀行委員會主席的民主黨參議員華倫(Elizabeth Warren)，直指輝達董事會的決定「魯莽」，認為董事會仍欠國會一個交代，必須說明公司遵守美國出口管制規定的情況。
華倫表示，黃仁勳回歸只會讓跨黨派出口管制法案的立法更加迫切，國會也必須確保輝達不會透過遊說阻擋相關法案，以免危及美國國家安全。對於議員的批評，輝達未立即回應。

共和黨議員質疑國安風險 籲查晶片銷往中國

共和黨眾議員貝肯(Don Bacon)表示，黃仁勳「遭中國間諜掌握弱點並加以利用」，輝達原本應在沒有黃仁勳的情況下繼續經營，而非理會川普政府「令人費解地想挽救黃仁勳」的意圖。
貝肯並要求國會徹查，究竟是誰批准向中國銷售高階運算晶片。
共和黨參議員柯寧(John Cornyn)也在社群平台X質疑董事會對國安風險的判斷，反問：「沒有國家安全風險？根據什麼？」

國會要求交代 黃仁勳預定12月1日接受閉門詢問

民主黨眾議員丁格爾(Debbie Dingell)表示，在國會甚至還沒有聽取黃仁勳說明之前，輝達董事會就決定讓他復職，是「不負責任的決定」。
她強調，目前仍有嚴重的國家安全問題尚待釐清，董事會必須解釋，為何願意在答案尚未出爐前就採取行動。
民主黨眾議員尼爾(Richard Neal)則指出，輝達董事會曾表示，復職決定參考了「美國政府高層的意見」。他認為，這正是國會必須查明事件真相的眾多原因之一。
根據共和黨參議員史考特(Tim Scott)助理的說法，黃仁勳上周已同意出席美國參議院公開聽證會。國會議員正調查黃仁勳與一名被認為是中國女間諜間的關係。此外，黃仁勳也同意於12月1日接受眾議院三個委員會的閉門詢問。
被視為潛在民主黨總統參選人的伊利諾州州長普里茨克(JB Pritzker)也批評這項決定，直言：「這正是國家剛剛才拒絕的貪婪與缺乏問責。」
隨著兩黨議員持續要求調查，黃仁勳雖已恢復執行長職務，但圍繞國家安全疑慮、對中晶片出口，以及川普政府在復職決策中扮演的角色，仍是國會關注的焦點。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump told CNBC on Monday (the 23rd) that he had urged Nvidia’s (NVDA‑US) board to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang and believes the board might not have made the move without his intervention. However, Trump’s backing of the personnel decision has sparked sharp criticism from lawmakers of both parties, and even Republican legislators are not buying it.
According to Reuters, lawmakers are questioning the reinstatement, demanding that Congress pass legislation to restrict chip exports to China and to clarify unresolved national‑security concerns.

Democratic Senator Elizabeth Warren, who is slated to become chair of the Senate Banking Committee in January, called Nvidia’s board decision “reckless,” saying the board still owes Congress an explanation and must detail how the company complies with U.S. export‑control rules.

Warren said Huang’s return will only heighten the urgency of bipartisan export‑control legislation, and Congress must ensure Nvidia does not lobby to block such bills, which could jeopardize U.S. national security. Nvidia did not immediately respond to the criticism.

Republican lawmakers question the security risk and call for a probe of chip sales to China. Republican Representative Don Bacon said Huang “has vulnerabilities that Chinese spies could exploit,” and that Nvidia should have continued operating without him rather than catering to the Trump administration’s “puzzling” desire to rescue Huang.
Bacon urged Congress to conduct a full investigation into who approved the sale of high‑end computing chips to China.
Republican Senator John Cornyn also took to X, questioning the board’s assessment of security risk and asking, “No national‑security risk? On what basis?”

Congress demands answers; Huang is slated for a closed‑door hearing on Dec. 1. Democratic Representative Debbie Dingell said it was “irresponsible” for Nvidia’s board to reinstate Huang before Congress had even heard his explanation.
She stressed that serious national‑security issues remain unresolved and that the board must explain why it acted before answers were available.

Democratic Representative Richard Neal noted that the board said the decision was based on “input from senior U.S. government officials,” and said that is one of many reasons Congress must uncover the truth.

According to an aide to Republican Senator Tim Scott, Huang agreed last week to appear at a public Senate hearing. Lawmakers are probing Huang’s ties to a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy, and he also agreed to a closed‑door hearing before three House committees on Dec. 1.

Illinois Governor J.B. Pritzker, seen as a potential Democratic presidential candidate, also criticized the move, saying, “This is exactly the greed and lack of accountability the nation has just rejected.”

As bipartisan lawmakers continue to call for investigations, Huang has resumed his CEO duties, but concerns over national‑security implications, chip exports to China, and the Trump administration’s role in the reinstatement remain focal points for Congress.

items.title: 車市停滯尋出路 福特入股衛星新創Revolution Space
items.title_en: Car Market Stalls, Seeking a Way Out; Ford Takes Stake in Satellite Startup Revolution Space
paras: 美國汽車大廠福特(F-US)正加速拓展汽車以外的新業務。據《彭博》周一(23日)報導，福特宣布取得美國衛星零件新創公司Revolution Space少數股權，計畫運用自身大量製造複雜產品的經驗，協助對方擴大衛星及推進技術的生產規模。
福特策略長賈賈(Marin Gjaja)在聲明中表示，與Revolution Space建立合作關係，協助其先進太空技術實現工業化與規模化，是福特在具吸引力的高成長市場推動業務多元化、令人振奮的機會。

汽車銷售停滯 福特積極尋找新商機

隨著全球汽車銷售趨於停滯，加上中國車廠持續在國際市場擴大市占率，傳統汽車製造商正積極尋找新的營收來源。
福特去年因電動車相關資產表現不佳，宣布認列195億美元減損，隨後著手建立儲能業務，希望利用尚未充分運用的電池工廠產能。此外，福特也尋求提高汽車零件業務的營收與獲利，並計畫向美國國防部銷售皮卡及軟體。
目前，美國國防部正尋求擴大承包商來源，以改善服務並降低成本，福特希望藉此開拓新的業務機會。

衛星推進技術成切入點 太空投資今年上看千億美元

總部位於波士頓的Revolution Space是美國政府承包商，主要生產衛星推進系統。福特此次透過旗下Ford Industrial LLC子公司進行投資，雙方均未公布投資金額及交易條件。
根據投資公司Space Capital對第三季投資活動的分析，受到SpaceX大型首次公開募股(IPO)、國防支出及太空基礎設施投資帶動，2026年太空經濟投資額可望首度突破1,000億美元。
汽車業者對太空產業的興趣也日益濃厚。豐田汽車(Toyota)與本田汽車(Honda)均已關注相關領域，其中豐田更積極投入投資，並於2025年初宣布向日本太空新創Interstellar Technologies投資4,400萬美元。
paras_en: Ford Motor Co. (F-US) is accelerating its expansion into businesses beyond automobiles. According to Bloomberg on Monday (the 23rd), Ford announced it has acquired a minority stake in U.S. satellite‑components startup Revolution Space, planning to leverage its large‑scale manufacturing expertise to help the company scale up production of satellites and propulsion technology.

Ford’s chief strategy officer Marin Gjaja said in a statement that partnering with Revolution Space to industrialize and scale its advanced space technology represents an exciting opportunity for Ford to diversify its business in an attractive high‑growth market.

Car sales have stalled, prompting Ford to actively seek new revenue sources. With global auto sales flattening and Chinese automakers continuing to expand market share internationally, traditional car makers are looking for fresh sources of income.

Last year, after poor performance of its electric‑vehicle assets, Ford recorded a $19.5 billion impairment and then moved to build a storage‑energy business, aiming to use under‑utilized battery‑factory capacity. The company is also seeking to boost revenue and profit from its auto‑parts operations and plans to sell pickups and software to the U.S. Department of Defense.
The U.S. Defense Department is currently looking to broaden its pool of contractors to improve service and cut costs, and Ford hopes to tap this effort to open new business opportunities.

Based in Boston, Revolution Space is a U.S. government contractor that primarily manufactures satellite propulsion systems. Ford is making the investment through its subsidiary Ford Industrial LLC; neither side disclosed the amount or terms of the deal.

According to Space Capital’s analysis of third‑quarter investment activity, driven by SpaceX’s large IPO, defense spending and space‑infrastructure investment, space‑economy investment could exceed $100 billion for the first time in 2026.

Automakers’ interest in the space sector is also growing. Both Toyota and Honda are watching the space arena, with Toyota taking a more active stance, having announced in early 2025 an investment of $44 million in Japanese space startup Interstellar Technologies.

items.title: 急跌後抄底多數能賺！歷史數據顯示 標普500暴跌10%後  91%機率會漲回來
items.title_en: Most Bottom‑Buyers Profit After Sharp Drops! Historical Data Shows a 91% Chance the S&P 500 Rebounds After a 10% Plunge
paras: 自標普500指數(INX) 迅速跌入技術性回調區間後，市場面臨一個關鍵問題：這究竟是更大規模下跌的開端，還是即將反彈的信號，而歷史統計與華爾街部分策略師的判斷正為後者提供依據。
DataTrek Research共同創辦人Jessica Rabe指出，自2015年以來，標普500在50個交易日內下跌10%的情形中，隨後50個交易日有91%​機率實現上漲，平均漲幅達10.5%。
值得注意的是，未能反彈的11次情況全部發生在2022年Fed激進升息衝擊期間。考慮到市場近期雖擔憂Fed釋放鷹派信號，但其是否會在市場動盪背景下繼續維持強硬立場仍存疑，這一歷史規律或能給投資者帶來一些安慰。
另據《MarketWatch》對其他歷史時期的統計也顯示，在市場下跌10%後買入，總體上仍較為有效，甚至在大蕭條期間，按標普500前身數據，這一策略多數情況下也取得正報酬。
波動率指標同樣釋放值得關注的信號。Rabe指出，VIX收於2021年以來第九高的水位，在此前八次類似高位中，有七次被證明是較好的入場時機。
Berge Report分析師Nancy Berge也表示，當週線VIX從30上方回落時，市場往往會出現一輪可觀反彈。週一早盤，標普500指數期貨上漲約2%，市場情緒有所修復。
摩根士丹利(下稱大摩)首席股票策略師Mike Wilson在最新研報告中轉向更樂觀立場，認為市場此前對明年企業獲利下滑的預期過於悲觀，回調已創造出值得關注的入場機會。這也是他自4月以來最為看多的一次。
Wilson將看多理由歸納為市場情緒、估值和投資者倉位三方面。大摩自有的市場情緒指標綜合波動率、資金流向和倉位等10項數據，目前已降至-1.6，為2018年12月及今年3月美伊戰爭爆發以來的低位。VIX一度升至36，與2018年12月相當，避險基金淨槓桿率降至41%，略低於當時水平。
企業基本面則是另一支撐。Wilson指出，目前獲利預期調整幅度為正10%，而2018年12月為負10%；同時美國勞動力市場仍相當穩健，初領失業金人數處於歷史分佈的最低百分位。獲利預期上調、企業利潤增長與就業韌性同時存在，缺乏足夠理由將當前回調解讀為2027年經濟衰退的前兆。
估值也顯示類似變化。當前股價已反映明年EPS下降6%的預期，但大摩分析師預估，明年EPS增長14%，市場一致預期更達17%；標普500本益比約16倍，低於大摩給出的19至19.6倍合理區間。
Wilson認為，此輪拋售已創造出具有吸引力的入場位置，而這樣的機會並不常見，也不會持續太久。
但看多判斷仍面臨一個重要風險，Fed恐繼續釋放鷹派信號。對此Wilson解釋指出，市場此前調整已在很大程度上替Fed收緊金融條件，美元走強、能源價格上漲，正在壓縮市場流動性，其水平已降至2022年以來低位，甚至比2018年12月更緊張。
因此，Wilson認為，當前市場對Fed政策路徑的定價可能過於鷹派，預計主席華許下月會議上釋放的信號，恐比債市目前預期的更溫和。
眼下，標普500的快速回調仍在考驗投資者信心。歷史數據、倉位出清與估值調整為反彈提供了依據，但Fed後續政策取向，仍是決定市場能否持續修復的重要變數。
paras_en: Since the S&P 500 index (INX) swiftly fell into a technical correction zone, the market faces a key question: is this the start of a larger decline or a signal of an imminent rebound? Historical statistics and some Wall Street strategists are leaning toward the latter.

DataTrek Research co‑founder Jessica Rabe notes that since 2015, in the 50‑day periods when the S&P 500 fell 10%, there is a 91% probability that it rises again in the following 50 days, with an average gain of 10.5%.

It is noteworthy that all 11 instances where a rebound did not occur happened during the aggressive Fed rate‑hike shock of 2022. While the market recently worries about hawkish signals from the Fed, doubts remain about whether the central bank will maintain a tough stance amid market turbulence, and this historical pattern may offer some comfort to investors.

MarketWatch’s statistics for other historical periods also show that buying after a 10% market drop remains generally effective, even during the Great Depression when using data from the S&P 500’s predecessor, the strategy still produced positive returns in most cases.

Volatility indicators are also sending noteworthy signals. Rabe points out that the VIX closed at its ninth‑highest level since 2021, and in the eight previous similar peaks, seven proved to be good entry points.

Berge Report analyst Nancy Berge adds that when the weekly VIX falls back below the 30‑level, the market often experiences a sizable rebound. On Monday morning, S&P 500 futures rose about 2%, and market sentiment improved.

Morgan Stanley (referred to as “MS”) chief equity strategist Mike Wilson turned more optimistic in his latest research note, arguing that the market’s prior expectations of lower corporate earnings next year were overly pessimistic, and the pullback has created attractive entry opportunities. This is his most bullish stance since April.

Wilson cites three reasons for his bullish view: market sentiment, valuation and investor positioning. MS’s proprietary sentiment index, which aggregates volatility, fund flows and positioning across ten data points, has fallen to –1.6, the lowest since December 2018 and the March 2024 US‑Iran conflict. The VIX briefly spiked to 36, comparable to December 2018, while hedge‑fund net leverage dropped to 41%, slightly below the level then.

Fundamentals provide another support. Wilson notes that earnings‑forecast adjustments are now +10% versus –10% in December 2018, and the U.S. labor market remains robust, with initial unemployment claims at the lowest percentile in historical distribution. The combination of upward earnings revisions, profit growth and employment resilience gives little reason to view the current pullback as a prelude to a 2027 recession.

Valuations also show a similar shift. Current stock prices already reflect an expected 6% EPS decline next year, yet MS analysts project a 14% EPS increase for next year, with the market consensus even higher at 17%; the S&P 500 price‑to‑earnings ratio sits around 16×, below MS’s fair‑value range of 19‑19.6×.
Wilson believes this round of selling has created an attractive entry point, a rare opportunity that will not last long.

However, the bullish case still faces a key risk: the Fed may continue to emit hawkish signals. Wilson explains that the market’s prior adjustment has already largely priced in the Fed’s tightening—stronger dollar, higher energy prices—compressing market liquidity to its lowest level since 2022, even tighter than December 2018.

Therefore, Wilson thinks the market may be over‑pricing the Fed’s policy path as hawkish, and expects that the signals Chairman Waller will deliver at next month’s meeting could be milder than the bond market currently anticipates.

At present, the S&P 500’s rapid pullback continues to test investor confidence. Historical data, position unwinding and valuation adjustments provide a basis for a rebound, but the Fed’s future policy direction remains the decisive factor for sustained market recovery.

items.title: 《彭博》揭輝達董事會閃電迎回黃仁勳內幕！川普施壓、高層最後一刻才知情
items.title_en: Bloomberg Reveals NVIDIA Board’s Lightning-Fast Return of Jensen Huang—Trump Pressure, Late‑Stage Executive Awareness
paras: 據《彭博》周一(23日)獨家報導，知情人士透露，輝達(NVDA-US)董事會突然決定恢復黃仁勳(Jensen Huang)的執行長職務，整個決策過程並未徵詢公司高階主管意見，管理團隊直到最後一刻才獲知消息。
這些人士表示，董事會周日下午在美國總統川普(Donald Trump)施加政治壓力後，決定讓先前遭撤換的黃仁勳重返執行長職位。由於相關討論並未公開，知情人士要求匿名。此外，部分原本可能接替黃仁勳的人選，也已表態不參與接班遴選。
據知情人士指出，輝達董事會迎回黃仁勳的計畫，周日短短數小時內便拍板定案，並於周一紐約股市開盤前不久正式宣布。過程中有川普參與，但代理執行長克瑞斯(Colette Kress)及其他高階主管都被排除在外。
在董事會改變決定之前，輝達管理團隊原本正準備迎接首度沒有黃仁勳出席的年度開發者大會。
這場活動預定下周在華盛頓舉行，如今隨著黃仁勳重返執行長職位，大會預料將成為他回歸輝達領導核心的重要舞台。
paras_en: According to Bloomberg’s exclusive Monday (23rd) report, insiders revealed that NVIDIA’s board abruptly decided to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, without consulting senior executives; the management team learned of the decision only at the last moment.

The insiders said the board, after political pressure from President Donald Trump on Sunday afternoon, chose to bring back the previously ousted Huang. The discussion was not public, so sources requested anonymity, and some potential successors declined to participate in the succession process.

Sources indicated that the board’s plan to re‑appoint Huang was finalized within hours on Sunday and formally announced just before Monday’s New York market opening. Trump was involved in the process, but interim CEO Colette Kress and other senior leaders were excluded.
Before the board reversed its decision, NVIDIA’s management had been preparing to host its first annual developer conference without Huang in attendance.
The event, scheduled for next week in Washington, is now expected to serve as a pivotal stage for Huang’s return to NVIDIA’s leadership core.

items.title: 創四個月低點！美國11月綜合PMI降至54.6 通膨壓力仍高
items.title_en: Four‑Month Low! US November Composite PMI Falls to 54.6, Inflation Pressure Remains High
paras: 綜合外媒周一(23日)報導，美國11月企業活動擴張速度降至四個月最慢，高物價抑制新訂單，運輸延誤與產能限制也拖累產出。不過，經濟與就業仍具韌性，通膨壓力持續偏高，也讓聯準會(Fed)對抗通膨面臨挑戰。

製造業與服務業同步降溫 供應鏈瓶頸加劇

標普全球(S&P Global)(SPGI-US)公布，11月綜合採購經理人指數(PMI)初值由10月終值55.9降至54.6，減少1.3點，但仍高於代表景氣擴張的50分界線。
製造業PMI由54.9降至54.5，創三個月低點；占美國經濟活動約三分之二的服務業，PMI則由56.1降至54.7，為四個月最低，顯示兩大產業成長同步放緩。
整體新訂單擴張速度降至7月以來最慢，服務業接單動能減弱，製造業新訂單則大致持平。與此同時，供應鏈瓶頸加劇，製造商供應商交貨時間延長幅度創2022年以來最大，反映全球貿易受阻與運輸延誤。
價格上漲速度雖降至8月以來最慢，企業仍承受投入成本與薪資壓力。標普全球市場財智首席商業經濟學家Chris Williamson警告，生活成本高漲正削弱民眾負擔能力，目前價格指標仍意味未來幾個月通膨將明顯高於Fed的2%目標。

就業持續擴張 第四季經濟成長仍具韌性

Williamson表示，近期製造業與服務業表現依然強勁，PMI仍指向第四季國內生產毛額(GDP)換算成年率成長約3%，顯示經濟擴張速度仍高於長期趨勢。
兩大產業也持續增聘人力，綜合就業指數連續第五個月處於擴張區間，預示11月非農就業人口可望再度穩健增加。美國10月非農就業已增加16.5萬人，優於預期。
今年以來，消費支出強勁、人工智慧(AI)建設投資與國防支出支撐企業業務及獲利，第三季經濟以年率計算成長3.4%。
期中選舉後，企業信心有所回升，但政治不確定性與高通膨仍限制成長預期。Williamson也提醒，供應中斷更加普遍，除影響履行訂單能力，未來幾個月還可能加重價格壓力。
此次調查期間為11月12日至20日，恰逢美股因AI熱潮能否延續的疑慮而大跌。股市原是支撐消費的重要力量，但調查尚無法確認，這波跌勢是否造成PMI走弱。
paras_en: On Monday (23rd), foreign media reported that US business activity in November slowed to its slowest pace in four months, with high prices suppressing new orders, transportation delays and capacity constraints dragging output. Nevertheless, the economy and employment remain resilient, and inflationary pressure remains high, posing a challenge for the Fed in fighting inflation.

Manufacturing and services cooled simultaneously, while supply‑chain bottlenecks intensified. S&P Global (SPGI‑US) released the November composite Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) preliminary reading, which fell from October's final 55.9 to 54.6, a decline of 1.3 points, yet still above the 50 threshold that signals expansion.

Manufacturing PMI fell from 54.9 to 54.5, a three‑month low; services, which account for about two‑thirds of US economic activity, fell from 56.1 to 54.7, a four‑month low, indicating that growth in the two major sectors is slowing in tandem.

Overall new‑order growth slowed to its slowest pace since July, with services' order‑taking momentum weakening and manufacturing new orders roughly flat. At the same time, supply‑chain bottlenecks worsened, with manufacturers' supplier lead times reaching their largest increase since 2022, reflecting global trade disruptions and transportation delays.

Price‑inflation slowed to its slowest pace since August, yet firms still face input‑cost and wage pressures. S&P Global Market Intelligence chief commercial economist Chris Williamson warned that high living costs are eroding consumer purchasing power, and current price indicators suggest inflation will remain well above the Fed's 2% target for the coming months.

Employment continues to expand, and economic growth in the fourth quarter remains resilient. Williamson noted that recent manufacturing and services performance remains strong, with the PMI implying a fourth‑quarter GDP annualized growth of about 3%, indicating that the pace of expansion is still above the long‑term trend.

The two major sectors continue to hire, with the composite employment index in expansion territory for the fifth consecutive month, suggesting that November non‑farm payrolls could again see a solid increase. US non‑farm payrolls rose 165,000 in October, beating expectations.

Since the start of the year, consumer spending has been robust, AI‑construction investment and defense spending have supported corporate activity and profitability, and the third‑quarter economy grew at an annualized rate of 3.4%.

After the midterm elections, corporate confidence has rebounded, but political uncertainty and high inflation still constrain growth expectations. Williamson also cautioned that supply disruptions are becoming more common, which not only affects order fulfillment but may also intensify price pressure in the coming months.

The survey period was November 12‑20, coinciding with a sharp drop in US equities as doubts over whether the AI boom would continue. The stock market has traditionally been a key driver of consumption, but the survey cannot yet confirm whether this decline contributed to the PMI weakening.

items.title: iPhone 18 Duo交貨等待近乎腰斬 小摩：蘋果旺季供應限制有望緩解
items.title_en: iPhone 18 Duo Delivery Wait Times Nearly Halved; JPMorgan: Apple’s Seasonal Supply Constraints Likely to Ease
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)iPhone 18系列供應持續改善。摩根大通最新追蹤報告顯示，iPhone 18 Duo全球平均交貨等待時間從前一周的72天縮短至37天，降幅接近五成，消費者預計收貨時間整體提前約一個月；Pro等待時間為2天，Pro Max則縮短至3天。摩根大通認為，供應可見度提高正改善蘋果的供需匹配，有望減輕供應限制對12月季度營收的影響。
不過，各市場改善程度不一。美國與中國的預計交貨日期分別提前至12月27日及26日，但兩地蘋果門市仍無法提供Duo現貨取貨；德國與英國則已有部分星光白配置開放門市取貨。這顯示Duo供應雖明顯改善，主要市場的現貨供應仍未完全恢復。

通路價格跌破官方售價 不等於需求轉弱

隨著Duo供貨增加，通路價格已跌破蘋果官方售價。先前缺貨推高通路成交價，如今交貨時間縮短、市場貨源增加，通路溢價自然面臨回落壓力。
摩根大通追蹤數據顯示，Duo交貨時間縮短主要與供應可見度提高有關。通路價格低於官方定價，不能單獨解讀為消費者需求轉弱，更不能直接等同於銷售不佳。

Pro系列恢復正常 中國門市全配色可取貨

Pro系列供應也進一步正常化。iPhone 18 Pro全球平均交貨等待時間較前一周增加1天至2天，仍接近可立即交貨；Pro Max則縮短5天至3天，已與去年同期持平。
分市場來看，Pro Max在美國、德國及英國的交貨等待時間均為4天，與去年同期一致。中國市場改善最為明顯，Pro與Pro Max等待時間都降至0天，所有配色均可於門市取貨。

旺季供應壓力減輕 美中現貨仍是觀察重點

整體而言，蘋果的供應改善已不再侷限於單一機型。隨著Duo交貨時間大幅縮短、Pro系列恢復至去年同期水準，蘋果在年底購物旺季可望以更充足的貨源因應需求，供應端對出貨與營收的限制正在減弱。
不過，Duo在美國與中國仍無法門市取貨，後續兩地的現貨供應何時恢復，將是觀察蘋果供貨改善程度的重要指標。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) iPhone 18 series supply continues to improve. JPMorgan’s latest tracking report shows the global average delivery wait for the iPhone 18 Duo fell from 72 days last week to 37 days, a drop of almost 50%, moving consumer receipt times forward by about a month; the Pro’s wait is now 2 days and the Pro Max’s has shortened to 3 days. JPMorgan believes higher supply visibility is improving Apple’s supply‑demand match and should lessen the impact of supply constraints on Q4 revenue.

However, the degree of improvement varies by market. Expected delivery dates in the United States and China have moved up to Dec 27 and Dec 26 respectively, but Apple stores in both regions still cannot offer Duo units for in‑store pickup; Germany and the United Kingdom already have some Star‑White configurations available for store pickup. This shows that while Duo supply has clearly improved, on‑hand inventory in key markets has not fully recovered.

Channel prices falling below Apple’s list price does not equal weakening demand. As Duo supply increases, channel prices have slipped beneath Apple’s official price. Previously, shortages pushed channel transaction prices higher; now shorter delivery times and more market inventory naturally put pressure on channel premiums to recede.

JPMorgan tracking data indicates the shorter Duo delivery times are mainly due to higher supply visibility. Prices below Apple’s list price should not be read as a sign of waning consumer demand, nor taken as a direct indication of poor sales.

Pro series supply also normalizes, with all colors available in Chinese stores. The iPhone 18 Pro’s global average delivery wait rose by one day to 2 days, still near‑instant delivery; the Pro Max’s wait shortened by 5 days to 3 days, matching the same period last year.

By market, Pro Max wait times are 4 days in the United States, Germany and the United Kingdom, unchanged from a year ago. The Chinese market shows the most improvement, with both Pro and Pro Max wait times dropping to 0 days and all colors available for in‑store pickup.

Reduced seasonal supply pressure; US‑China inventory remains a key watch‑point. Overall, Apple’s supply improvements are no longer limited to a single model. With Duo delivery times sharply cut and the Pro line back to last‑year levels, Apple should be able to meet holiday‑season demand with a fuller inventory, easing supply‑side constraints on shipments and revenue.

Nevertheless, Duo remains unavailable for in‑store pickup in the United States and China. When on‑hand inventory returns in these two markets will be a crucial indicator of how far Apple’s supply improvements have progressed.

items.title: 誰能代表美國民主黨角逐2028白宮？12場初選辯論明年6月開打
items.title_en: Who Can Represent the U.S. Democratic Party in the 2028 White House Race? 12 Primary Debates Kick Off in June Next Year
paras: 美國民主黨已開始為2028年總統大選布局。據《紐約時報》周一(23日)報導，民主黨全國委員會(DNC)宣布，計畫為2028年總統初選舉辦12場辯論，首場預定於明年6月登場，屆時民主黨的總統提名戰局可能仍充滿變數。
除了公布辯論場次與時間，DNC也提出初步參與規則。其中一項承諾若獲落實，將要求候選人公開譴責不揭露捐款者身分的外部團體為其投入助選資金。候選人也須同意，不參加其他任何同時有兩名以上候選人出席的活動。
DNC主席馬丁(Ken Martin)表示，這套公平、透明的程序，加上經驗豐富的領導團隊，將有助於維持黨內團結、強化最終提名人的競爭力，讓民主黨有機會重新奪回白宮。

參選人數恐爆棚 最多20人登上辯論舞台

民主黨在期中選舉大勝後，2028年總統大選的布局逐漸升溫。儘管目前尚無主要人選正式宣布參選，潛在參選人已陸續出席華盛頓與丹佛的活動，而可能擔任競選經理及其他高階幕僚的人士，也預計12月在紐約集會。
《紐約時報》指出，2028年民主黨初選可能是近一個世代以來最開放的提名戰之一。2020年共有28人角逐民主黨提名，這次潛在人選同樣涵蓋知名州長、參議員，以及希望提高知名度的政治與媒體人士。
DNC表示，若符合資格的候選人過多，將考慮分成兩組、連續兩晚舉辦辯論，參與人數上限為20人。民調與募款門檻、辯論地點及合作媒體預計明年1月公布，內容創作者與網路意見領袖也將參與辯論相關活動。

辯論新規劍指「暗錢」 限制秘密助選合作

這次辯論規則的最大變化，是針對俗稱「暗錢」(dark money)的政治資金提出新要求。
2020年民主黨初選期間，多數候選人曾非正式同意拒絕超級政治行動委員會(Super PAC)助選，但拜登(Joe Biden)並未加入。這項共識後來瓦解，就連強烈反對相關資金的麻州參議員華倫(Elizabeth Warren)，最終也接受超級政治行動委員會支持。
這次DNC辯論規畫委員會將由資深黨務人士摩爾(Minyon Moore)及DNC執行主任勞(Roger Lau)領導，並設法落實「公平競選行為」承諾，禁止候選人與超級政治行動委員會進行秘密合作。這類合作在美國聯邦選舉中已相當普遍。

辯論一路排到2028年3月 大選階段不受新規限制

DNC規畫的12場辯論將持續至2028年3月，未來可能增加場次。其中，揭開提名程序的前六場早期州辯論，都將安排在2028年舉行。
今年4月，佛蒙特州無黨籍參議員桑德斯(Bernie Sanders)呼籲DNC要求各級選舉候選人拒絕超級政治行動委員會及暗錢資金支持。馬丁當時表示認同，但強調若要在初選中禁止這類做法，必須取得黨內廣泛承諾。
不過，外界普遍預期，多數主要總統參選人仍將獲得支持自己的超級政治行動委員會協助，DNC的新承諾究竟會對這些組織產生多大影響，仍有待觀察。
DNC也說明，針對超級政治行動委員會及暗錢資金的相關限制僅適用於初選，不適用於正式大選階段。
paras_en: The Democratic Party has already begun laying the groundwork for the 2028 presidential election. According to a New York Times report on Monday (the 23rd), the Democratic National Committee (DNC) announced plans to hold 12 debates for the 2028 presidential primary, with the first scheduled for June next year, when the Democratic nomination race could still be full of uncertainty.

In addition to publishing the debate schedule and dates, the DNC also released preliminary participation rules. One commitment, if implemented, would require candidates to publicly condemn external groups that do not disclose donor identities for contributing campaign funds. Candidates must also agree not to attend any other event that has more than two candidates present at the same time.

DNC chair Ken Martin said that this fair, transparent process, combined with an experienced leadership team, will help maintain party unity, strengthen the competitiveness of the eventual nominee, and give the Democrats a chance to retake the White House.

The number of candidates could swell, with up to 20 people on the debate stage. After a big win in the midterms, the 2028 presidential race planning is heating up. Although no major figure has formally announced a run yet, potential candidates have been appearing at events in Washington and Denver, and prospective campaign managers and senior staff are expected to gather in New York in December.

The New York Times noted that the 2028 Democratic primary could be one of the most open nomination battles in a generation. In 2020, 28 people vied for the Democratic nomination; this time, the field is expected to include well‑known governors, senators, and political or media personalities looking to raise their profile.

The DNC said that if too many qualified candidates emerge, it will consider splitting the debates into two groups held on consecutive nights, with a maximum of 20 participants. Polling and fundraising thresholds, debate locations and partner media are slated to be announced in January, and content creators and online influencers will also take part in debate‑related events.
The biggest change to the debate rules targets so‑called “dark money” political funding, imposing new requirements on such contributions.

During the 2020 Democratic primary, most candidates informally agreed to reject Super PAC assistance, but Joe Biden did not join that consensus. That agreement later fell apart, and even Massachusetts Senator Elizabeth Warren, a strong opponent of such funding, eventually accepted Super PAC support.

The DNC debate planning committee, led by veteran party official Minyon Moore and DNC executive director Roger Lau, will work to enforce a “fair campaign conduct” pledge that bans candidates from secret collaborations with Super PACs, a practice that is already common in U.S. federal elections.
The 12 debates planned by the DNC will run through March 2028, with the possibility of adding more. The first six early‑state debates that open the nomination process are all scheduled for 2028.

In April, independent Vermont Senator Bernie Sanders urged the DNC to require candidates at all levels to reject Super PAC and dark‑money support. Martin at the time expressed agreement but stressed that banning such practices in the primary would require broad party commitment.

Nevertheless, observers generally expect that most major presidential contenders will still receive assistance from Super PACs that back them, and it remains to be seen how much impact the DNC’s new pledge will have on those organizations.
The DNC also clarified that the restrictions on Super PACs and dark‑money funding apply only to the primary stage and not to the official general‑election phase.

items.title: 黃仁勳一回來就重傷空頭！輝達3倍放空產品暴跌逾91%
items.title_en: Jensen Huang’s Return Deals a Heavy Blow to Short Sellers! Nvidia 3x Inverse Product Plummets Over 91%
paras: 黃仁勳重返輝達(NVDA-US)執行長職位，帶動股價周一(23日)一度大漲約34%，卻讓押注股價下跌的槓桿產品遭遇重擊。一檔在歐洲掛牌的3倍放空輝達產品，盤中一度暴跌逾91%，並曾暫停交易。
綜合財經網站ZeroHedge與ETF專業媒體ETF Stream報導，Leverage Shares發行的3倍反向輝達交易所交易產品(ETP)，其倫敦掛牌、美元計價版本NV3S，一度從上周五收盤的3.475美元跌至0.30美元，跌幅達91.37%。若以上周五收盤價買進，按此價格計算，部位市值僅剩原本約8.6%。
彭博行業研究ETF分析師Eric Balchunas在社群平台X分享相關報價畫面，也指出該產品英鎊計價版本曾顯示「自動暫停交易：超出容許波動範圍」的訊息，引發市場關注。
這場逆轉之前，押注輝達下跌的交易才剛帶來可觀報酬。NV3S從11月9日的約1.75美元，漲至上周五的約3.48美元，短短兩周價格接近翻倍，光是上周五便上漲約37%。
但川普周日晚間公開呼籲輝達重新聘用黃仁勳後，公司董事會周一便宣布讓他即刻復職，並表示在取得美國政府高層意見後，確信其回任不構成國安風險。消息推升輝達股價，也讓反向產品先前的漲勢急轉直下。
這類產品為何跌得如此劇烈？依發行商說明，其目標是在扣除費用前，提供輝達「單日報酬的反向3倍」。簡單來說，輝達若上漲1%，產品理論上便下跌約3%；但遇到盤中再平衡與極端行情時，實際報酬不能直接以整天股價漲幅乘以負3計算。
Leverage Shares也設有被稱為「安全氣囊」的盤中再平衡機制，當標的股價出現約16.67%的不利變動時觸發，以降低極端行情下的損失風險。
據ETF Stream報導，這次急漲確實觸發了該機制，產品暫停交易後已恢復交易。Leverage Shares全球傳訊與策略主管Oktay Kavrak表示，產品並未歸零，安全氣囊發揮了降低全部損失風險的作用。同日，GraniteShares另一檔3倍放空輝達產品3SNV，也一度下跌約92.1%。
Balchunas將這次暴跌與2018年的反向波動率商品XIV事件相提並論。當年市場波動劇烈，XIV指示價值重挫，觸發提前贖回條款，發行商隨後宣布提前贖回。兩者追蹤標的與結構不同，但都呈現出反向產品在行情突然逆轉時，損失可能迅速擴大的特性。
paras_en: Jensen Huang returned to his role as CEO of Nvidia (NVDA-US), sending the stock soaring about 34% on Monday (the 23rd) before dealing a severe hit to leveraged products betting on a price decline. A Europe‑listed 3‑times short Nvidia product plunged more than 91% during trading and was briefly halted.

According to financial site ZeroHedge and ETF‑focused media ETF Stream, Leverage Shares’ 3‑times inverse Nvidia exchange‑traded product (ETP), the London‑listed, USD‑denominated version NV3S, fell from its Friday‑close of $3.475 to $0.30, a drop of 91.37%. Buying at Friday’s close would leave the position’s market value at only about 8.6% of its original amount.

Bloomberg industry‑research ETF analyst Eric Balchunas shared the price chart on X and noted that the GBP‑denominated version of the product displayed a “trading automatically halted: exceeded allowed volatility range” message, drawing market attention.

Before this reversal, the short Nvidia trade had just delivered sizable returns. NV3S rose from roughly $1.75 on Nov 9 to about $3.48 last Friday, almost doubling in two weeks and gaining about 37% on Friday alone.

After former President Trump publicly urged Nvidia to re‑hire Jensen Huang on Sunday night, the board announced on Monday that he would resume his duties immediately, saying that after consulting senior U.S. officials they were confident his return posed no national‑security risk. The news lifted Nvidia’s share price and abruptly reversed the inverse product’s prior rally.

Why did the product fall so dramatically? The issuer explains that its goal is to deliver three times the inverse of Nvidia’s daily return before fees. In simple terms, a 1% rise in Nvidia should cause roughly a 3% drop in the product, but intra‑day rebalancing and extreme moves mean the actual return can’t be calculated by merely multiplying the day’s price change by –3.

Leverage Shares also incorporates an “airbag” intra‑day rebalancing mechanism that triggers when the underlying moves about 16.67% against the position, intended to reduce loss risk in extreme markets.

ETF Stream reported that the sudden surge indeed triggered the mechanism; after the product’s trading halt it resumed trading. Oktay Kavrak, Global Communications and Strategy Head at Leverage Shares, said the product did not go to zero and the airbag helped limit total loss risk. On the same day, GraniteShares’ 3‑times short Nvidia product 3SNV also fell about 92.1%.

Balchunas likened the crash to the 2018 inverse volatility product XIV episode, when severe market turbulence caused XIV’s indicative value to collapse, triggering early redemption provisions and a subsequent redemption announcement. Although the underlying assets and structures differ, both cases illustrate how inverse products can incur rapid, large losses when market direction flips suddenly.

items.title: 〈台幣〉股匯雙紅力守33元大關！盤中觸32.999元 午後翻升收32.895元
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar and Stocks Both Red, Guarding the 33‑TWD Barrier! Hit 32.999 TWD Mid‑day, Rose to Close at 32.895 TWD
paras: 台北外匯市場今（23）日上演戲劇性逆轉秀，新台幣兌美元早盤一度下探32.999元，逼近33元整數大關。不過隨著台股強勁反彈大漲逾770點，加上出口商拋匯力道湧現，新台幣午後由貶翻升，終場收在32.895元、升值4.1分，台北外匯經紀公司成交金額達22.03億美元，呈現股匯雙紅格局。
回顧今日匯市交易走勢，新台幣兌美元以32.95元貶值1.4分開出，早盤雖一度微幅走揚，但隨即因外資資金匯出需求仍在，拖累匯價迅速翻貶。上午盤中最低下探至32.999元，距離33元整數關卡僅有0.1分之遙，午盤則暫收在32.99元、貶值5.4分。
進入午後交易時段，市場氛圍出現明顯轉折。在金管會限空令上路、國安基金進場護盤等穩市措施激勵下，台股信心大振並強勢反彈，終場大漲779點收在36812點。股市止跌回升有效緩解外資匯出壓力，同時出口商見匯價逼近33元大關積極進場拋匯，帶動新台幣一路走高。
新台幣午後不僅收復早盤失土，盤中最高更觸及32.89元價位，高低震盪幅度達1.09角。終場台北外匯市場收在32.895元，升值4.1分，單日成交金額擴增至22.03億美元，顯示在33元整數關卡前，買賣雙方交投相當熱絡。
外匯交易員分析，上週台股重挫期間，新台幣匯率表現已相對抗跌，今日更在台股強彈與出口商實質拋匯買盤支撐下，成功守住33元重要心理關卡並演出翻紅行情。不過，今日三大法人在台股仍呈現賣超格局，顯示外資尚未全面回頭。
短線國際金融市場仍受美國聯準會利率政策預期及科技股波動牽動，美元指數維持高檔震盪格局。後續仍須密切關注外資在台股的進出動向，以及月底出口商拋匯力道的延續性，預計短線新台幣仍將在32.8元至33元區間震盪整理。
paras_en: The Taipei foreign‑exchange market staged a dramatic reversal today (23rd). The New Taiwan dollar (NTD) against the US dollar slipped to 32.999 in early trading, edging close to the 33‑point whole‑number barrier. However, as the Taiwan stock index rallied strongly, gaining more than 770 points, and exporters flooded the market with sell‑off orders, the NTD turned from depreciation to appreciation in the afternoon, closing at 32.895 – a gain of 4.1 cents. Taipei FX brokers reported a turnover of US$2.203 billion, reflecting a dual‑red (stock and currency) scenario.

Looking back at today’s FX flow, the NTD opened at 32.95, down 1.4 cents. Although it rose slightly in early trading, persistent outflows of foreign capital quickly pushed the rate down again. The intraday low in the morning reached 32.999, just 0.1 cent shy of the 33‑point mark, and by lunch the rate was temporarily at 32.99, down 5.4 cents.

In the afternoon session the market mood shifted markedly. Stabilisation measures such as the Financial Supervisory Commission’s short‑selling ban and the entry of the National Security Fund to support the market boosted confidence, sending the Taiwan stock index soaring 779 points to close at 36,812. The stock market’s rebound eased foreign‑capital outflow pressure, while exporters, seeing the rate near the 33‑point barrier, aggressively sold dollars, driving the NTD higher.

The NTD not only reclaimed the ground lost in the morning but also peaked at 32.89 during the session, with a high‑low swing of 1.09 cents. The Taipei FX market closed at 32.895, up 4.1 cents, and daily turnover expanded to US$2.203 billion, indicating lively trading on both sides of the 33‑point psychological level.

FX traders noted that during last week’s stock market plunge the NTD already showed relative resilience. Today, buoyed by the stock rally and concrete sell‑off buying from exporters, the currency successfully defended the important 33‑point psychological barrier and turned red. Nevertheless, the three major institutional investors still posted net selling in the stock market, suggesting foreign capital has not fully returned.

Short‑term international financial markets remain influenced by expectations around the U.S. Federal Reserve’s rate policy and tech‑stock volatility, keeping the dollar index in a high‑level oscillation. Ongoing attention is needed on foreign‑capital flows in Taiwanese equities and the sustainability of exporters’ dollar‑selling at month‑end. The NTD is expected to continue oscillating between 32.8 and 33 in the near term.

Last week U.S. initial jobless claims rose slightly, suggesting a stable labor market, and the Philadelphia Fed President Powell supported further rate hikes. Inflation data came in hotter than expected, bolstering speculation that the Federal Reserve will tighten policy. On Friday the dollar held near a 19‑month high, but AI spending worries and debt‑burden concerns triggered a global equity sell‑off, and Anthropic’s record‑size IPO failed to lift sentiment, prompting investors to flee to safe‑haven assets and add yen buying. Japan’s October core CPI rose 2.2% YoY, missing forecasts, but the core‑CPI that excludes fresh food and fuel – the metric the BOJ watches for demand‑driven inflation – also rose 2.2% YoY, the second consecutive month above the BOJ’s 2% target, reinforcing the case for a near‑term rate hike. Finance Minister Shindo said the Japanese economy shows encouraging signs of wages and prices rising together, with firms gradually passing higher costs to consumers, accelerating underlying consumption inflation. Ahead of the Tokyo settlement, dollar selling pressure outweighed import‑related buying, and anticipated repatriation of funds used for hedging overseas Japanese assets is expected to support the yen, pulling USD/JPY down from the 159.83 peak.

Following that, the University of Michigan’s final November U.S. consumer confidence index came in at –51.5, in line with expectations, while one‑year and five‑year inflation expectations fell to 3.7% and 3.3% respectively. Fed Governor Cook said current rates are still insufficient to curb inflation, backing another hike. Meanwhile, U.S. Treasury yields slipped, weakening the dollar’s appeal and dragging USD/JPY down to a low of 158.40. Concerns over AI prospects also battered global equities and pushed commodity prices lower, sending the Aussie dollar and New Zealand dollar to eleven‑month and six‑year lows respectively on Friday, and pulling the euro‑dollar down to a low of 1.0956.

items.title: 波斯灣戰火升溫！川普再威脅伊朗：新年後不達協議就空襲
items.title_en: Tensions Rise in the Persian Gulf! Trump Threatens Iran Again: Airstrikes If No Agreement After New Year
paras: 美國總統川普週日(22日)接受《福斯新聞》獨家專訪時再度對伊朗發出軍事威脅稱，若美伊無法達成協議，他傾向於新年後下令發動新一輪軍事打擊。他同時痛批正在進行的外交談判，指責伊朗談判代表故意拖延時間，並在美國期中選舉後加劇敵對行動。
川普表示，他們現在比選舉前更咄咄逼人，並將伊朗談判代表稱為「職業踢踏舞演員」，嘲諷「他們整天都在談，除了談還是談，但全是廢話」。
目前美國仍對伊朗港口實施海上封鎖，荷姆茲海峽周邊軍事對抗持續，川普預期美伊軍隊之間仍可能發生相互報復性打擊。他甚至公開表示，希望伊朗嘗試突破封鎖，「他們最終都會沉到海底，就像他們其他海軍艦艇一樣」。
與此同時，伊朗多座城市再現反政府示威。川普也直接向伊朗抗議者喊話：「繼續抗議。」
此前幾日，川普曾稱不急於決定重新採取軍事行動，並多次指出1月1日之後是美國應對衝突的潛在轉折點。
另據《CNBC》報導，川普發言之際，波斯灣地區軍事摩擦正快速升級，沙烏地阿拉伯與巴林上週末均稱遭伊朗相關武裝力量攻擊。
由沙國領導、打擊胡塞武裝的「支持葉門合法政府聯盟」週日在X上發文：「防空系統攔截並摧毀一架飛向利雅德地區的無人機，週六晚間還攔截一枚飛向沙國西部重要能源煉油與出口設施的彈道飛彈。」
巴林也報告遭襲。巴林內政部也在X上表示，一處民用工業設施遭伊朗襲擊起火，造成兩人受傷，分別是一名巴林公民和一名巴基斯坦籍居民。巴林是美國海軍第五艦隊駐地。
伊朗國家媒體上週六(21日)晚間報導指出，該國革命衛隊向美國駐巴林軍事設施發射飛彈和無人機，還稱防空系統攔截一架美軍MQ-9無人機；美國中央司令部尚未回應置評請求。
英國海事貿易行動辦公室(UKMTO)也通報指出，上週六阿曼附近有兩艘油輪遭不明飛行物襲擊。
不過，軍事緊張並未阻擋國際油價走低，交易商認為中東原油供應依然充足，加上美國原油庫存持續增加，油價連三週下跌。
目前，美伊雙方在海上海封鎖、荷姆茲海峽通行及最終協議條件上仍存明顯分歧，隨著波斯灣國家接連遇襲，軍事對抗與外交斡旋並行，中東能源供應與地區安全仍籠罩在不確定性之中。
paras_en: On Sunday (22nd), U.S. President Donald Trump, in an exclusive interview with Fox News, once again issued a military threat to Iran, saying that if the U.S. and Iran cannot reach an agreement, he would be inclined to order a new round of military strikes after the New Year. He also blasted the ongoing diplomatic talks, accusing Iran’s negotiating representatives of deliberately delaying time and escalating hostility after the U.S. midterm elections.

Trump said that they are now more aggressive than before the election, and called Iran’s negotiating representatives “professional tap dancers,” mocking that “they talk all day, they talk, they talk, but it’s all nonsense.”

The United States still imposes a maritime blockade on Iranian ports, and military confrontations around the Strait of Hormuz continue. Trump expects that there may still be retaliatory strikes between U.S. and Iranian forces. He even publicly stated that he hopes Iran will try to break the blockade, saying, “They will eventually sink to the bottom of the sea, just like their other naval vessels.”
Meanwhile, anti-government protests have reappeared in several Iranian cities. Trump also directly shouted at Iranian protesters, “Keep protesting.”

In the days before, Trump said he was not in a hurry to decide on re‑taking military action, and repeatedly pointed out that after January 1st is a potential turning point for the U.S. response to the conflict.

According to CNBC, as Trump spoke, military friction in the Persian Gulf was rapidly escalating, and Saudi Arabia and Bahrain both claimed they had been attacked by Iranian‑affiliated armed forces over the weekend.

The Saudi-led “Support the Legitimate Government of Yemen” coalition posted on X on Sunday: “The air defense system intercepted and destroyed a drone heading toward the Riyadh area, and on Saturday night it also intercepted a ballistic missile heading toward a major energy refinery and export facility in western Saudi Arabia.”

Bahrain also reported an attack. Bahrain’s Ministry of Interior posted on X that a civilian industrial facility was attacked by Iran, caught fire, and injured two people—a Bahraini citizen and a Pakistani resident. Bahrain hosts the U.S. Navy’s Fifth Fleet.

Iranian state media reported on Saturday night (21st) that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps fired missiles and drones at U.S. military facilities in Bahrain, and claimed that the air defense system intercepted an American MQ‑9 drone; the U.S. Central Command has not yet responded to a request for comment.
The UK Maritime Trade Operations office (UKMTO) also reported that two oil tankers near Oman were attacked by unidentified flying objects on Saturday.

However, military tensions did not stop international oil prices from falling. Traders believe that Middle Eastern oil supply remains ample, and U.S. crude inventories continue to rise, causing oil prices to fall for three consecutive weeks.

Currently, the U.S. and Iran still have clear differences over maritime blockades, passage through the Strait of Hormuz, and final agreement terms. As Gulf states continue to face attacks, military confrontation and diplomatic negotiations run in parallel, leaving Middle Eastern energy supply and regional security shrouded in uncertainty.

paras: 美元指數週五 (20 日) 小幅走低，終止連八個交易日上漲。市場對人工智慧 (AI) 產業的疑慮持續衝擊全球股市，資金轉進美國公債避險，帶動殖利率下滑，推升日元與瑞郎。不過，聯準會 (Fed) 官員持續釋出鷹派訊號，加上市場降低對風險貨幣的持有意願，限制美元跌幅。
美股尾盤時段，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣表現的美元指數下跌 0.07%，至 103.87，仍接近前一交易日觸及、2025 年 4 月以來的最高水準。
美元這波漲勢在 11 月 10 日加速，當時美國通膨數據高於預期，強化市場對聯準會進一步緊縮政策的押注。聯準會理事沃勒 (Christopher Waller) 也表示，應考慮在 12 月升息 2 碼。
Bannockburn Capital Markets 首席市場策略師 Marc Chandler 表示：「我認為美元的上漲動能已經停滯……但現在就認定美元已經見頂，還有點太早。」
美債避險買盤湧現 日元、瑞郎受惠
AI 相關疑慮持續壓抑全球股市，Anthropic (ANT-US) 週四創紀錄的上市案，也未能有效提振投資人信心。資金週五轉向公債避險，推動美債殖利率下滑，提高日元與瑞郎等低利率貨幣的相對吸引力。
Chandler 表示：「當美國利率下降時，低收益貨幣就顯得更具吸引力。」
美元兌瑞郎下跌 0.51%，報 1 美元可兌換 0.8396 瑞郎；美元兌日元下跌 0.73%，報 1 美元可兌換 158.50 日元，顯示瑞郎與日元雙雙兌美元升值。日元匯價仍接近日本當局今年 7 月進場干預、支撐日元時的水準。
除了美債殖利率下降，日本通膨數據也提供日元支撐。日本 10 月核心消費者物價指數 (CPI) 年增率加速至 2.2%，連續第二個月高於日本銀行的 2% 目標，顯示物價壓力擴散，強化日銀近期升息的理由。
Chandler 指出：「日元今天走強，受到美國利率下降，以及日本 10 月 CPI 表現強勁的帶動。」
凱投宏觀分析師認為，日元近期的疲弱走勢不太可能持續。
隨著日本長期通膨預期已接近目標，殖利率進一步上升將主要反映實質利率提高，加上該機構預期美債殖利率將下降，兩項因素應有利日元。
聯準會維持鷹派 川普再批利率過高
儘管美元回落，策略師認為，聯準會偏向升息的政策前景仍將提供支撐。
ING 全球市場主管 Chris Turner 表示，雖然目前支持股市再度大幅修正的理由有限，但「聯準會沒有理由在短期內放棄鷹派論調」。
他指出，下週公布的美國個人消費支出物價指數 (PCE)，可能進一步確認聯準會有必要採取行動。
聯準會理事庫克 (Lisa Cook) 週五也支持進一步升息，表示目前政策利率不足以因應通膨，並稱她對通膨水準「深感憂慮」。
美國總統川普則在週五記者會上表示，目前利率過高，並批評聯準會具有「政治性」。
其他主要貨幣方面，歐元兌美元小跌至 1.0963 美元；英鎊兌美元下跌至 1.3080 美元，仍徘徊在一年低點附近。澳元與紐元分別下跌 0.71% 及 0.36%，反映風險貨幣持續承壓。
加密貨幣也遭拋售浪潮襲擊。
隨著投資人擔憂 AI 相關資產估值過高，賣壓擴及其他風險資產，比特幣週五跌破 6 萬美元，為 7 月以來首見，報導更新時下跌約 6%，至 57,939 美元。

paras_en: The U.S. dollar index slipped slightly on Friday (the 20th), ending an eight‑day winning streak. Ongoing concerns about the artificial‑intelligence (AI) sector continued to weigh on global equities, prompting a shift into U.S. Treasury safe‑haven assets, which pushed yields lower and boosted the yen and Swiss franc. However, hawkish signals from Federal Reserve officials and reduced appetite for risk currencies limited the dollar's decline.

In the late‑session of U.S. equities, the dollar index, which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.07% to 103.87, still near the highest level reached on the previous trading day, the peak since April 2025.

The dollar's recent rally accelerated on November 10 when U.S. inflation data came in hotter than expected, strengthening market bets on further Fed tightening. Fed Governor Christopher Waller also said a 25‑basis‑point rate hike in December should be considered.
Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Capital Markets, said: “I think the dollar’s upward momentum has stalled… but it’s still a bit early to declare that the dollar has peaked.”
U.S. Treasury safe‑haven buying lifts yen and franc

AI‑related worries kept global equities under pressure, and even Anthropic’s (ANT‑US) record‑setting IPO on Thursday failed to lift investor confidence. On Friday, funds moved into Treasury safe‑haven assets, driving U.S. bond yields lower and raising the relative appeal of low‑yield currencies such as the yen and Swiss franc.
Chandler added: “When U.S. rates fall, low‑yield currencies become more attractive.”

The dollar fell 0.51% against the franc to $1 = 0.8396 CHF, and 0.73% against the yen to $1 = 158.50 JPY, indicating that both currencies appreciated versus the greenback. The yen rate remains close to the level at which Japanese authorities intervened in July to support the currency.

In addition to falling U.S. yields, Japanese inflation data also supported the yen. Japan’s October core consumer‑price index (CPI) annualised rate accelerated to 2.2%, the second consecutive month above the Bank of Japan’s 2% target, showing broader price pressure and bolstering the case for a recent BOJ rate hike.
Chandler noted: “The yen’s strength today is driven by falling U.S. rates and the strong October CPI reading in Japan.”
Macro analyst at KGI believes the yen’s recent weakness is unlikely to persist.

With Japan’s long‑term inflation expectations now near target, any further rise in yields will mainly reflect higher real rates, and the institution expects U.S. Treasury yields to fall – two factors that should benefit the yen.
Fed Maintains Hawkish Stance as Trump Again Criticises High Rates
Even though the dollar retreated, strategists say the Fed’s bias toward rate hikes will continue to provide support.

Chris Turner, head of global markets at ING, said that while there are limited reasons at present to justify another sharp equity correction, “the Fed has no reason to abandon its hawkish tone in the short term.”
He added that next week’s U.S. personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index could further confirm the Fed’s need to act.
Fed Governor Lisa Cook also backed further tightening on Friday, saying current policy rates are insufficient to curb inflation and expressing “deep concern” about inflation levels.
Former President Donald Trump told reporters on Friday that rates are currently too high and criticized the Fed as being “political.”

Among other major currencies, the euro slipped to $1.0963, the pound fell to $1.3080, hovering near a one‑year low, while the Australian and New Zealand dollars dropped 0.71% and 0.36% respectively, reflecting continued pressure on risk assets.
Cryptocurrencies also came under selling pressure.

As investors worried that AI‑related assets were overvalued, selling spread to other risk assets and Bitcoin fell below $60,000 on Friday – the first time since July – dropping about 6% to $57,939 at the time of the update.

The dollar weakened 0.51% to CHF 0.8396 per dollar.
The dollar rose 0.03% to C$1.4344 per dollar.

items.title_en: New Taiwan Dollar: Central Bank Strongly Stabilizes, Closes at 32.936, Up 0.6 Points
paras: 台股加權指數今(20)日再度破底，市場出現強烈的去槓桿壓力，單日跌點達2393點，創史上第三大跌點，一周來已跌掉7641點，周跌幅17.5%，台北匯市見到中央銀行全力穩盤調節，新台幣終場收在32.936元，升值0.6分，與股市脫鉤，台北外匯經紀公司成交值則縮至21.02億美元。
新台幣今日以32.96元、貶值1.8分開出後，盤中一度轉升值，午盤過後又見貶值壓力湧出，收盤半小時又轉升，顯示來回拋補的拉鋸力道激烈，但成交量萎縮，全日高低價差1.2角。
觀察主要亞幣，日元強彈超過0.4%，人民幣升0.3%，星元升0.15%上下，泰銖升約0.1%，新台幣收升0.02%，而韓元貶值約0.1%。
法人分析，聯準會官員有提到AI的蓬勃發展正在加劇經濟過熱風險，企業投資達到空前規模但經濟產能未必承受得住，使聯準會將不得不應對短期影響，而這些影響目前看來是推升通膨，在此鷹派聲浪下，暫難見到帶動外資回頭的訊號，使匯市偏弱整理。
paras_en: The Taiwan weighted index broke its low again today (20th), with the market under strong deleveraging pressure. It fell 2,393 points in a single day, the third‑largest point drop in history, and has lost 7,641 points over the past week, a weekly decline of 17.5%. In the Taipei foreign‑exchange market the central bank stepped in forcefully to stabilize the currency; the New Taiwan dollar closed at 32.936, appreciating 0.6 points and decoupling from the equity market. Turnover at Taipei FX brokers shrank to US$2.102 billion.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 32.96, down 1.8 points, then rose briefly during the session. After the midday break, depreciation pressure resurfaced, but in the half‑hour before close it turned upward again, showing a fierce tug‑of‑war between buying and selling. However, trading volume contracted and the daily high‑low range was only 0.12 yuan.

Among the major Asian currencies, the Japanese yen surged more than 0.4%, the Chinese renminbi rose 0.3%, the Singapore dollar gained about 0.15%, the Thai baht edged up roughly 0.1%, the New Taiwan dollar finished up 0.02%, while the South Korean won depreciated about 0.1%.

Analysts note that Federal Reserve officials have warned that the rapid growth of AI is heightening the risk of an overheated economy. Corporate investment is reaching unprecedented levels, but productive capacity may not keep pace, forcing the Fed to address short‑term impacts that currently appear to be feeding inflation. Amid this hawkish sentiment, there is little sign of foreign capital returning, leaving the FX market in a weak, consolidating stance.

According to the October Federal Reserve (FED) meeting minutes, policymakers unanimously agreed to keep rates unchanged for now, but said inflation risks may require stronger action. In Japan, September core machinery orders rose 13.4% year‑on‑year, missing expectations but falling 0.3% month‑on‑month, better than forecast. Reuters surveys show most economists expect the Bank of Japan (BOJ) to announce its third rate hike of the year in December and another hike before the end of March 2025. items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Gains Pause as Anthropic IPO Boosts Risk Appetite, Yen Depreciates
paras: 美元週四(19日)兌多數主要貨幣回落，近期漲勢暫歇。人工智慧(AI)公司Anthropic即將掛牌，提振市場風險偏好，削弱美元買盤。不過，聯準會(Fed)官員的鷹派談話與最新會議紀錄，仍使進一步升息的預期支撐美元，美元指數維持在約19個月高點附近。
美股尾盤時段，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.2%，報103.65；歐元兌美元上漲0.2%，報1.1002美元。
美元指數本週觸及2025年4月2日以來最高水準。當時，美國總統川普宣布大規模關稅措施，引發美國資產賣壓。
美元這波漲勢始於11月10日，當時美國通膨數據高於預期，促使投資人提高對聯準會緊縮政策的押注。聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)呼籲採取更積極措施對抗通膨，而10月27日至28日的會議紀錄也顯示，決策官員愈來愈擔心，可能需要進一步緊縮政策。
加拿大豐業銀行首席外匯策略師奧斯本(Shaun Osborne)表示：「美元這段時間已經漲了不少，我認為目前匯價已反映許多利多。」
他指出，美元多頭若要在短期內推升匯價，需要更強的信心或更多利多消息。他並將美元部分回落，歸因於Anthropic首次公開發行(IPO)前，市場風險情緒改善。
Anthropic的IPO定價高於原先行銷區間，帶動週四那斯達克期貨上漲，也提高市場對其上市表現的期待，重新提振AI類股投資情緒。
巴克萊分析師則認為，財政刺激與強勁的AI相關資本支出，反映美國經濟具有韌性，也意味經濟產出高於潛在水準的幅度可能擴大，利率將在更長時間內維持高檔，這些因素均有利美元。
儘管近期科技股遭到拋售，美元仍獲得資金流入支撐。德意志銀行追蹤逾100檔在美國境外註冊的指數股票型基金(ETF)發現，外國投資人過去兩週大舉逢低買進美股，買進力道為今年最強，顯示流向美股的資金也是支撐美元的重要因素。
隨著風險偏好回升、避險需求降溫，日元兌美元走貶。美元兌日元上漲0.4%，報159.905日元兌1美元，中止連續四個交易日下跌。
分析師指出，若AI相關資產再度遭到拋售，避險買盤與資金匯回日本可能支撐日元，但日元兌其他貨幣的升勢，可能比兌美元更為明顯。
澳幣兌美元則大致持平。澳洲10月就業人數連續第二個月減少，失業率升至五年高點，強化市場對當地利率可能已觸頂的看法。
三菱日聯金融集團(MUFG)資深外匯分析師 Lee Hardman表示，市場大幅上調對聯準會升息的預期，正對大宗商品價格及相關貨幣形成壓力。
瑞銀考量澳洲通膨仍高，以及勞動與房市情況惡化，將澳洲央行首次降息時間預測，由明年11月提前至8月，並將預估降息次數由兩次增加至三次。
英鎊兌美元升值0.1%，報1英鎊兌1.3162美元，但英鎊兌歐元則從20個月高點回落。投資人仍看好英國利率前景，同時對歐洲2027年多場重要選舉可能為歐元帶來的阻力保持警戒。
加密貨幣方面，受風險偏好改善帶動，比特幣上漲2.5%，報63,870美元，脫離上週日觸及的四個月低點62,026美元。

paras_en: The dollar fell against most major currencies on Thursday (the 19th), pausing its recent rally. The upcoming IPO of AI company Anthropic lifted market risk appetite and weakened dollar buying pressure. However, hawkish comments from Federal Reserve officials and the latest meeting minutes still support expectations of further rate hikes, keeping the dollar index near a 19‑month high.
In the late‑day US equity session, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, slipped 0.2% to 103.65, while the euro rose 0.2% to $1.1002.
The dollar index this week reached its highest level since April 2, 2025, when President Trump announced large‑scale tariff measures that triggered selling pressure on US assets.

The current dollar rally began on November 10, when US inflation data came in above expectations, prompting investors to increase bets on tighter Fed policy. Fed Governor Christopher Waller called for more aggressive action against inflation, and the minutes from the Oct. 27‑28 meeting showed policymakers growing increasingly concerned that further tightening may be needed.

Shaun Osborne, chief FX strategist at Canada’s BMO Capital Markets, said: “The dollar has already risen a lot in recent weeks, and I think the current exchange rates already reflect much of the upside.”

He added that for dollar bulls to push rates higher in the short term they would need stronger conviction or more positive news, and he attributed the dollar’s partial pullback to improved market risk sentiment ahead of Anthropic’s IPO.
Anthropic’s IPO was priced above its initial marketing range, lifting Nasdaq futures on Thursday and raising expectations for its market debut, which revived sentiment toward AI‑related stocks.

Barclays analysts argue that fiscal stimulus and robust AI‑related capital spending show the US economy is resilient, suggesting output may be running above potential for longer, keeping rates high – a backdrop that benefits the dollar.

Despite recent tech‑stock sell‑offs, the dollar continued to attract inflows. Deutsche Bank, tracking over 100 offshore‑registered ETFs, found foreign investors bought US equities in large volumes over the past two weeks – the strongest buying this year – indicating that capital flowing into US stocks also underpins the dollar.
With risk appetite recovering and hedging demand easing, the yen weakened against the dollar. The USD/JPY rose 0.4% to 159.905 yen per dollar, ending a four‑day decline.

Analysts note that if AI‑related assets face another sell‑off, safe‑haven buying and capital returning to Japan could support the yen, but the yen’s gains against other currencies may be more pronounced than against the dollar.

The Australian dollar was roughly flat versus the US dollar. October employment in Australia fell for the second consecutive month, pushing the unemployment rate to a five‑year high and reinforcing market views that local rates may have peaked.
Lee Hardman, senior FX analyst at MUFG, said the market’s sharp upgrade of expectations for Fed rate hikes is putting pressure on commodity prices and related currencies.

UBS, considering still‑elevated Australian inflation and worsening labour and housing conditions, moved its forecast for the Reserve Bank of Australia’s first rate cut from November next year to August and increased the expected number of cuts from two to three.

The pound rose 0.1% to $1.3162, but the GBP/EUR slipped from a 20‑month peak. Investors remain bullish on UK rate prospects while staying cautious about the potential drag on the euro from several major European elections slated for 2027.
In crypto, improved risk appetite lifted Bitcoin 2.5% to $63,870, pulling it out of the four‑month low of $62,026 hit last Sunday.

paras: 台北股匯市遭逢雙殺壓力，除了金管會自明(20)日起再祭出五大穩定股市措施，包括重啟「有條件禁空令」，中央銀行也積極調節匯市波動，終場收在32.942元，升值0.5分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值則縮至22.63億美元。
新台幣今日以32.96元、貶值1.3分開出後，最低一度貶至33.04元，但觸及33元心理大關後貶勢並未擴大，收盤前15分鐘更轉升，收在32.942元，高低價差1.2角。
由於成交值較昨日見收斂，法人解讀資金拋補大鬥法已稍微緩解，不過，尚未見到台股的止跌訊號，匯市能否就此守住無形的33元防線，仍受到市場密切關注。
觀察主要亞幣，日元貶值約0.3%，新台幣收升0.02%，星元和人民幣微幅波動不到0.05%，韓元升0.1%左右，泰銖升0.2%，而美元指數小跌近0.1%。
法人指出，聯準會內部鷹派釋出12月應考慮升息2碼的訊息，令市場風險意識持續提高，同時，後黃仁勳時代的AI投資焦慮高漲，AI估值調整壓力持續消化中。
值得留意的是，獨立新創AI Anthropic將在台灣時間今日晚上掛牌，掛牌行情成另一個左右市場信心的重要焦點。
paras_en: Taipei stock and forex markets faced double‑kill pressure. Starting today (20th), the Financial Supervisory Commission rolled out five major measures to stabilise the stock market, including re‑instating the "conditional short‑selling ban". The central bank also actively adjusted FX market volatility, ending the session at 32.942, up 0.5 points, while the turnover of Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage firms shrank to $2.263 billion.

The New Taiwan dollar opened today at 32.96, down 1.3 points, fell to a low of 33.04, but after hitting the psychological 33‑level the decline did not deepen. In the last 15 minutes before close it turned higher, finishing at 32.942, with a daily range of 1.2 jiao.

Because turnover narrowed compared with yesterday, institutional investors interpret that the large‑scale fund‑outflow battle has eased somewhat, yet no clear bottoming signal has appeared for the Taiwan stock market. Whether the FX market can now hold the intangible 33‑level barrier remains under close market scrutiny.

Looking at major Asian currencies, the Japanese yen weakened about 0.3%, the New Taiwan dollar rose 0.02%, the Singapore dollar and the Chinese yuan fluctuated less than 0.05%, the Korean won rose roughly 0.1%, the Thai baht rose 0.2%, while the US dollar index slipped nearly 0.1%.

Institutions note that hawkish voices inside the Fed have signalled that a 20‑basis‑point rate hike should be considered in December, raising market risk awareness. At the same time, AI‑investment anxiety is soaring in the post‑Jensen Huang era, and pressure from AI valuation adjustments continues to be digested.
Worth noting is that the independent AI startup Anthropic will list tonight Taiwan time, and its debut price will become another key focus influencing market confidence.
